title: HMS Kurdistan human sign-off record
description: One YAML file per record under docs/safety/signoffs/, named <id>.yaml, added by a named human in a signed git commit (BUILD-PROMPT.md §3.5; docs/safety/signoffs/README.md). The build agent never writes these files. `sh tools/hms safety check` validates every record against this schema, checks that the commit that added it is signed, and matches each filled approval field to a record with the same subject and field.

id.description: SO-<year>-<4-digit sequence>; the file name is <id>.yaml.

subject.description: The artefact the sign-off is about: a hazard id (HAZ-0005), a control id (CTRL-0005-9), a state-machine name (medication-administration), risk-vocabulary, or another artefact id.

subject_version.description: Optional version of the subject the sign-off applies to (for example a state-machine spec version or a commit SHA of the hazard log).

field.description: The approval field this record authorises, as a dotted path inside the subject, for example residual_risk.accepted_by, cso_triage, approval.approved_by. A record for a parent path (cso_triage) authorises its children (cso_triage.by, cso_triage.date).

role.description: The role in which the person signs, for example Clinical Safety Officer, Chief CSO, pharmacist panel member, laboratory CSO.

name.description: The full name of the person who signs. The value written into the approval field must equal this name (or the record id).

date.description: Date of the decision (YYYY-MM-DD). A filled cso_triage.date must equal it.

statement.description: What exactly is approved, accepted or triaged, in the signer's words, including any conditions.

decision.description: Optional outcome. A record without a decision, or with 'approved', 'accepted' or 'triaged', authorises its field; 'rejected' and 'returned' are kept as history and authorise nothing.

evidence.description: Optional references to the evidence reviewed (paths, test-run records, review reports).

supersedes.description: Optional id of an earlier record this one replaces.

method.description: MVP: the record is added in a git commit signed by the named person (GPG or SSH signature that git verifies). Other methods need an ADR.

signer_key.description: Optional fingerprint or key id the signer uses, for the reviewer's cross-check.
